newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares seen drifting, incentives lacking.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares seen drifting, incentives lacking.

text.p: Singapore shares were seen drifting on Wednesday with investors not prepared to commit to the market, a dealer said.
"There are no incentives for buyers," the dealer with a local firm said.
The Straits Times Industrials Index edged up 2.09 points to 1,977.10 on Tuesday and showed no signs of sustaining a determined spurt forward.
Blue chip stocks were expected to continue to be shunned in favour of small cap and electronics counters as retail buyers sought out the bargain basement.
